_comment: Copy to config.json. allowed_channels = Slack channel IDs the bot will respond in (invite @ISAIC to each). Get an ID from a channel's About panel or a message link. default_model: 'auto' or a provider id (claude/deepseek/gemini/mistral/qwen/glm/kimi). channel_preferences maps a channel ID to a provider id.
_theme_comment: Cosmetic skin (display-only — never changes the canonical [Claude] reply label or routing). 'isaic' (default; twelve tribes !judah/!joseph/!zebulun/!naphtali/!benjamin/!gad/!issachar/!levi), 'eva' (MAGI cast), or 'nightvale' (the five heads of Hiram McDaniels). Canonical bare prefixes (!claude/!deepseek/...) always work.
_providers_comment: OPTIONAL. Omit 'providers' to keep defaults (each head enabled iff its API key is present, on its default backend). When present it OVERRIDES per-provider: enabled / backend / model / routing_tags, and per-backend sub-blocks (e.g. self_hosted).
_participation_comment: Automatic social gate. One active speaker gets session mode (the bot answers normally). A second speaker inside activation_minutes, or a human replying to another human in a Slack thread, starts ambient mode. Mentions, replies after the bot's own thread turn, commands, and model prefixes always work; obvious human-to-human turns stay silent; ambiguous exceptional interventions use cheap Haiku. Speaker switches renew the ambient hold, one speaker alone does not. After solo_reset_hours without multi-speaker evidence, session mode returns. !presence shows or overrides this per channel.

providers._kimi_comment: Kimi K3 (2.8T MoE, 1M ctx) defaults to FIREWORKS serverless here — US/ZDR, rides the same FIREWORKS_API_KEY as Qwen/GLM, $3/$15 with $0.30 cached (Moonshot-identical). Override-only in routing (!kimi / !issachar / !prefer kimi) — it prices above Claude on input. Do NOT flip it to the 'moonshot' backend on the lab bot (China-resident endpoint; egress rule).
providers._backend_options: deepseek.backend: 'api' | 'fireworks' (FIREWORKS_API_KEY) | 'self_hosted'. mistral.backend: 'api' (api.mistral.ai) | 'together' (TOGETHER_API_KEY) | 'self_hosted'. gemini.backend: 'developer_api' | 'vertex' (GCP ADC + google-cloud-aiplatform). kimi.backend: 'fireworks' (default) | 'moonshot' (NOT for the lab bot). sim: point providers.sim.base_url at a /completions endpoint and set enabled=true.
